title: Where a field is used
summary: Tells for each field name whether the project index finds it in a DFM control, a grid column, a lookup or code; the Select Fields dialog of the IDE draws its usage icons from it
intro: Read this when you want to know which fields of a table are really used before you edit, rename or drop them. drag-lint repo field-usage --fields "ID,QTY" --json answers from the project index, per field, with the places it is used: dfm, grid, lookup, code. A field nothing uses is left out. The IDE Select Fields dialog runs it to show the icons.

questions.ask: Which of these fields is used in a form, a grid, a lookup or code?
Is this field safe to drop, or does a DFM control or code still name it?
